name: alacarte
description: Downloads albums from Apple Music through alacarte. alacarte files each album in its own music folder, and Aurral plays it from there.

settings.label: alacarte URL
settings.help: Like http://alacarte-web:7373 when both containers share a Docker network.

settings.label: Integration token
settings.help: In alacarte, under Settings > Integrations. Turn the integration on there first.

settings.label: Tracks requested at once
settings.help: How many tracks the plugin asks alacarte for at a time, across all albums. alacarte downloads one at a time either way. Default 3.
